Our story so far

  1. 2019

    Founded in a spare room

    Two designers, one shared desk and a stubborn idea about calmer websites.

  2. 2020

    First ten clients

    Word of mouth did the marketing. We learned to say no politely.

  3. 2022

    Opened the studio

    A proper space with north light, a library and a very good kettle.

  4. 2024

    Design system toolkit

    Released the open toolkit now used by more than 4,000 teams.

  5. 2026

    Looking ahead

    Smaller projects, deeper partnerships and more time to experiment.
